author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
Join me for a while, waiting for the sun to rise over the hills in Southern Spain, as the beautiful morning light gradually changes and various animals wake up for the day and the nocturnal ones go quiet.
.
Slow TV isn't for everyone - nothing is scripted here - no narration or music - nothing much happens, and certainly not on purpose, but that's OK - there are no sudden loud noises in this video and no midroll ads. Mostly you will just hear the calls of birds and insects, as well as the sounds of human activity, dogs performing their morning barks and such.

This video was recorded near Puerto de Mazarrón, Murcia, looking towards Las Peñas Blancas (The White Cliffs) - which I explored in a different video here: https://youtu.be/yQQU-p3ZR_c
